verses.text: “Rule and awe belong to God. He makes peace in his high places.
Can anyone count his armies? Is there anyone his light doesn’t rise on?
So how can a person be in the right before God? How can anyone born of a woman be clean?
Look, even the moon has no brightness, and even the stars aren’t pure in his sight.
How much less a human being, just a worm, a human child who’s no more than a worm!”
